dialogues.speaker: Lila
dialogues.text: *sob* ...The doctor is a meanie, grandma! The shot she gave me hurt!

dialogues.speaker: Tahmina
dialogues.text: Haha. No, sweetheart, this lady here isn't being a meanie. She's here as a representative of the Dendro Archon.

dialogues.speaker: Tahmina
dialogues.text: You're like an unwell little tree, Lila. What the doctor is doing is nourishing you.

dialogues.speaker: Lila
dialogues.text: I know the Dendro Archon is a good person... Does that mean that the doctor is a good person too?

dialogues.speaker: Tahmina
dialogues.text: Yes. Listen to her, and you'll grow tall and strong.

dialogues.speaker: Tahmina
dialogues.text: Otherwise, the Eremites will take you away for defying the Dendro Archon!

dialogues.speaker: Lila
dialogues.text: No, no! They're scary! I don't want that...
